alt: Bars show an honest but unfinished library scoring 5.39, 18.93 and 17.87 out of 100 on the original grader because failed calls counted as fast; the fixed version scores 0.
caption: Calls that failed or did nothing finished instantly, so the original grader paid up to 18.93 points for unfinished code; the fixed version checks each timed call's result and pays nothing for these.
